keyPoints.en: BMA ruled from September 1945 to March 1946.
keyPoints.bm: BMA memerintah dari September 1945 hingga Mac 1946.

keyPoints.en: Tasks: restore order, food supply, rebuild infrastructure, handle MPAJA.
keyPoints.bm: Tugas: memulihkan keamanan, bekalan makanan, membina semula infrastruktur, menangani MPAJA.

keyPoints.en: Problems: inflation, shortages, black market and ethnic tension.
keyPoints.bm: Masalah: inflasi, kekurangan, pasaran gelap dan ketegangan kaum.

keyPoints.en: Began 1 April 1946; Governor Sir Edward Gent.
keyPoints.bm: Bermula 1 April 1946; Gabenor Sir Edward Gent.

keyPoints.en: United 9 Malay states + Penang + Melaka; Singapore separate.
keyPoints.bm: Menyatukan 9 negeri Melayu + Pulau Pinang + Melaka; Singapura berasingan.

keyPoints.en: Rulers kept power only over Islam and Malay custom.
keyPoints.bm: Raja hanya berkuasa dalam hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

keyPoints.en: Citizenship by jus soli and liberal conditions.
keyPoints.bm: Kerakyatan secara jus soli dan syarat longgar.

keyPoints.en: MacMichael got the signatures through pressure (Oct–Dec 1945).

tip.en: Learn the 4 key features as G-J-R-W: Governor, Jus soli, Rulers weakened, Wilayah united.
tip.bm: Ingat 4 ciri utama G-J-R-W: Gabenor, Jus soli, Raja dilemahkan, Wilayah disatukan.

keyPoints.en: Pan-Malayan Malay Congress, March 1946 at Kelab Sultan Sulaiman.
keyPoints.bm: Kongres Melayu Se-Malaya, Mac 1946 di Kelab Sultan Sulaiman.

keyPoints.en: UMNO founded 11 May 1946, led by Dato' Onn Jaafar.
keyPoints.bm: UMNO ditubuhkan 11 Mei 1946, dipimpin Dato' Onn Jaafar.

keyPoints.en: Rulers boycotted Gent's installation; Malays wore white bands for 7 days.
keyPoints.bm: Raja memulaukan pelantikan Gent; orang Melayu memakai kain putih selama 7 hari.

keyPoints.en: Former British officers (Swettenham, Winstedt) also objected.
keyPoints.bm: Bekas pegawai British (Swettenham, Winstedt) turut membantah.

keyPoints.en: Result: the Union was replaced by the Federation of Malaya in 1948.
keyPoints.bm: Hasil: Malayan Union digantikan dengan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu pada 1948.

keyPoints.en: Sarawak ceded by Charles Vyner Brooke; Sabah by the British North Borneo Company (1946).
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak diserahkan oleh Charles Vyner Brooke; Sabah oleh Syarikat Borneo Utara British (1946).

keyPoints.en: Anti-cession movement in Sarawak, e.g. Persatuan Kebangsaan Melayu Sarawak.
keyPoints.bm: Gerakan antipenyerahan di Sarawak, cth. Persatuan Kebangsaan Melayu Sarawak.

keyPoints.en: Rosli Dhobi (Rukun 13) killed Governor Duncan Stewart in Sibu, December 1949.
keyPoints.bm: Rosli Dhobi (Rukun 13) membunuh Gabenor Duncan Stewart di Sibu, Disember 1949.
